_comment: The reel package's own manifest. Copy this directory to your reel package root, then copy the kit into src/.
These versions are the ones the kit is tested against on every commit by scripts/kit-check.mjs in the
product-reel repo, so they are pins rather than suggestions. Keep remotion and every @remotion/* package on
the same exact version or the bundler and the renderer disagree in ways that surface as a blank frame rather
than an error. Add @remotion/fonts when the product ships its own font files. The product's own dependencies
still renders frame 480 on purpose. Frame 0 is the reel's fade from black, so a default still is a
solid black image that looks identical whether the toolchain works or not.
name: reel
